[EN] The Sihrans were installing these stones when we arrived. We killed them before they finished.

They sealed that gate as they retreated.

We need a way in!
[ES] Los Sihrans estaban instalando estas piedras cuando llegamos. Los matamos antes de que terminaran.

Sellaron esa puerta al retirarse.

¡Necesitamos una forma de entrar!
